title: Setting the Record Straight on “Grindr Outages”
summary: Is Grindr down? Despite the jokes, political conventions and large gatherings don’t cause Grindr outages. Here’s how to check Grindr’s real-time status.
body_markdown:
We get it: “Grindr is down” has become a familiar punchline whenever a political convention comes to town.


But the claim is false. Grindr does not experience outages because of conventions, political events, or other large gatherings.


Third-party outage trackers rely on self-reported user complaints, which can spike for any number of reasons. When Grindr has a confirmed service incident, we report it directly on our[status page](https://status.grindr.com/history) .


And, for the technically curious: a crowded venue can strain local cellular or Wi-Fi networks, making any app harder to use.


Politics has enough jokes. Being gay isn’t one.
